name: Dhanalaxmi Roto Spinners Limited
about: Dhanalaxmi Roto Spinners Limited trades in paper and wood pulp in India. The company offers wood pulp products, including fluff, bleached hardwood, dissolving, unbleached, bleached softwood, bagasse, reclaimed fluff, bleached chemi-thermomechanical, bleached hardwood, and off-grade pulp products, as well as pulp wrappers. It also provides paper products, such as sack kraft, bag kraft, kraft liner boards, and art papers; and other paper grades, including wood free, printing/writing, newsprint, and specialty papers. Dhanalaxmi Roto Spinners Limited was founded in 1986 and is based in Hyderabad, India.
